name: Pudina Chai
steps: Pick the mint leaves from any tough stems and rinse them in several changes of water. Drain well and lightly tear the leaves just before using.
Bring the water to a boil, add the tea leaves and simmer for 2 minutes. Add half the mint and cook for another 1 minute so its aroma enters the brew.
Add the milk and sugar and stir. Bring to a gentle boil, lower the heat and simmer for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent a skin forming at the bottom.
Switch off, add the remaining mint and cover for 1 minute. Strain immediately into four cups; the tea should smell fresh and minty rather than taste like overcooked greens.
tips: Adding some mint after switching off preserves its fragrance; do not leave the leaves sitting in the finished tea.
notes: Four cups of fresh mint milk tea. Contains milk and caffeine.
